verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic desktop IDE, and automated PR review is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no automatic review that runs on every pull request. Its Diff Review only lets you accept or reject the agent's own local edits. The GitHub plugin gives the agent PR access, which is a building block rather than an automatic contextual review feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
